request: Tag_Status.vi calls plc_tag_status and returns the current tag status code

candidates.prompt: One SQUARE 1:1 flat software icon on white for querying the current status of a PLC tag. A large blue tag above a thick orange heartbeat trace; the zigzag must be bold and clearly visible. Show no checkmark, no red error warning, no success/failure result, no extra text or tiny detail. Thick clean geometry, high contrast, generous white margin, no border or shadow.

source.evidence: A blue tag sits above an orange pulse trace; no success or failure is asserted.

29x29.evidence: Tag and zigzag line are distinct.

30x23.evidence: The pulse peak and tag remain recognizable.

30x18.evidence: The orange pulse remains distinct from the blue tag.

16x16.evidence: The zigzag becomes coarser but the dominant tag-and-pulse form survives.

candidates.prompt: One SQUARE 1:1 flat software icon on white for querying the current status of a PLC tag. A simple blue tag at left, and at right a tall orange panel containing three large separate white circular indicator lights. No single light is selected. Show no checkmark, no red error warning, no success/failure result, no extra text or tiny detail. Thick clean geometry, high contrast, generous white margin, no border or shadow.

signature.composition: tag left and vertical three-light panel right

source.evidence: A tag is beside an orange three-light panel with no individual state selected.

29x29.evidence: All three white lights and tag remain separate.

30x18.evidence: The three unselected indicators and tag remain visible.

16x16.evidence: The lights soften but remain grouped as an indicator panel.

candidates.prompt: One SQUARE 1:1 flat software icon on white for querying the current status of a PLC tag. A large navy tag with a large white question mark centered inside. The question mark asks for the tag's current status; it does not indicate an error. Show no checkmark, no red error warning, no success/failure result, no extra text or tiny detail. Thick clean geometry, high contrast, generous white margin, no border or shadow.

source.evidence: A large white question mark in the tag suggests a status query, though it may also suggest an unknown tag.

29x29.evidence: The question mark and tag silhouette are clear.

30x23.evidence: The question mark remains distinct from the tag hole.

30x18.evidence: The large question mark remains recognizable within the tag.

16x16.evidence: The mark and tag remain but the question-mark dot becomes smaller.

candidates.prompt: One SQUARE 1:1 flat software icon on white for querying the current status of a PLC tag. Show no checkmark, no red error warning, no success/failure result, no extra text or tiny detail. Thick clean geometry, high contrast, generous white margin, no border or shadow.

signature.composition: round dial around tag with pointer above

source.evidence: A tag sits below a neutral semicircular gauge and pointer, conveying a generic state.

29x29.evidence: Gauge arc, pointer and tag are separate.

30x23.evidence: The gauge needle remains visible above the tag.

30x18.evidence: The orange arc, black needle and blue tag remain distinguishable.

16x16.evidence: Gauge and tag survive while needle detail softens.

candidates.prompt: Create exactly one SQUARE 1:1 flat software icon on a white background. Show a single large dark-blue report page with a folded top-right corner. Inside the page place one large orange tag shape occupying the upper half and one thick white horizontal status line in the lower half. The page itself must dominate the silhouette; the tag and one line must stay separate at 30x18 pixels. Represents a report of the current tag status. No speech bubble, no warning triangle, no checkmark, no words or numbers, no shadow. Leave generous white margins.

signature.objects: report page, tag and status line
signature.composition: tag inside page above bold status line

source.evidence: A dark report page contains an orange tag and one white status line; the page avoids the error icon's speech-bubble layout.

29x29.evidence: The folded page, tag and status line are distinct.

30x23.evidence: The tag and single line remain visible within the page.

30x18.evidence: The orange tag, white status line and page fold remain recognizable.

16x16.evidence: The page and orange tag remain, while the tag hole softens.
